name: Stamps Pre-College Portfolio Prep
org: University of Michigan Stamps School of Art and Design
what_you_do: Build an art and design portfolio for college in a 2 week studio program with Stamps faculty. Learn about art school admission from the Stamps admission team.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 11 who are interested in art and design.
pay_detail: 2026: $6,000 for a residential session (living on campus), or $750 online. Some full and partial scholarships go to students with need and merit.
duration: 2 weeks. 2026 sessions: online June 15 to 26; residential July 12 to 25 or July 26 to August 8.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. The early action deadline was February 1, 2026 and the final deadline was March 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply on the Stamps summer pre-college page when 2027 applications open. You can sign up there for news and info sessions now.
notes: Michigan residents in a residential session can also apply for the Watson A. Young scholarship. Stamps is not running fall pre-college programs this year.
